from pathlib import Path

p = 'src/data/lyrics/ae-be-bradr-zainab.md'

        assert u.splitlines()[0] == chr(0x06f0 + i)
print('Roman preserved exactly; preamble and nine numbered stanzas align.')

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu-script preamble and nine stanzas in [ae-be-bradr-zainab.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/workspaces/c8338380ba8b46da878a7f5b23ff1d63/src/data/lyrics/ae-be-bradr-zainab.md). Preserved the Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`, verified stanza alignment, set the direction to RTL, and removed `noUrdu`.

For the ambiguous readings, I rendered “Bhi yaar-o-yaawar” as «بے یار و یاور», “Ayaabe” as «آیا بہ», and “daama dam” as «دامادم».
